Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.MaxRayIntensity
Rendering.desc: Clamps the maximum ray lighting intensity (with PreExposure) to reduce fireflies.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.ResamplingAngleThreshold
Rendering.desc: Largest angle between two reservoirs that will be allowed during reservoir resampling, in degrees

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.ResamplingDepthErrorThreshold
Rendering.desc: Largest depth error between two reservoirs that will be allowed during reservoir resampling

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.ShortRangeAO
Rendering.desc: Whether to compute a short range, full resolution AO to add high frequency occlusion (contact shadows) which ReSTIR GI lacks due to spatial filtering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.ShortRangeAO.MaxScreenTraceFraction
Rendering.desc: Short range AO tracing distance, as a fraction of the screen size.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.SpatialResampling
Rendering.desc: Whether to use spatial resampling passes on the reservoirs

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.SpatialResampling.KernelRadius
Rendering.desc: Radius of the spatial resampling kernel as a fraction of the screen.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.SpatialResampling.NumPasses
Rendering.desc: The number of spatial resampling passes to do

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.SpatialResampling.NumSamples
Rendering.desc: The number of spatial samples for each resampling pass.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.SpatialResampling.OcclusionScreenTraceDistance
Rendering.desc: Length of occlusion screen traces used to validate the neighbor's reservoir hit position before reuse, to reduce leaking.  As a fraction of the screen size.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Temporal
Rendering.desc: Whether to use a temporal filter

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Temporal.ClearHistoryEveryFrame
Rendering.desc: Whether to clear the history every frame for debugging

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Temporal.DistanceThreshold
Rendering.desc: Relative distance threshold needed to discard last frame's lighting results.  Lower values reduce ghosting from characters when near a wall but increase flickering artifacts.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Temporal.MaxFramesAccumulated
Rendering.desc: Lower values cause the temporal filter to propagate lighting changes faster, but also increase flickering from noise.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.TemporalResampling
Rendering.desc: Whether to do a temporal resampling pass on the reservoirs

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.TemporalResampling.ValidateEveryNFrames
Rendering.desc: Validate temporal reservoirs by re-tracing their rays and comparing hit positions and radiance every N frames.  Used to reduce lag in lighting changes, but introduces noise.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Upsample.KernelSize
Rendering.desc: Upsample kernel size, in reservoir texels

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Upsample.Method
Rendering.desc: Upsample method, when calculating full resolution irradiance from downsampled reservoir radiance  0 - Jittered bilinear sample, when jittered position lies in the same plane, and fallback to unjittere

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Upsample.NumSamples
Rendering.desc: Number of reservoir samples to take while upsampling. Only used when r.Lumen.ReSTIRGather.Upsample.Method is set to Spiral Pattern.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.SampleFog
Rendering.desc: Sample the fog contribution in Lumen tracing. Disabled by default.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather
Rendering.desc: Whether to use the Screen Probe Final Gather

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.AdaptiveProbeAllocationFraction
Rendering.desc: Fraction of uniform probes to allow for adaptive probe placement.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.AdaptiveProbeMinDownsampleFactor
Rendering.desc: Screen probes will be placed where needed down to this downsample factor of the GBuffer.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DiffuseIntegralMethod
Rendering.desc: Spherical Harmonic = 0, Importance Sample BRDF = 1, Numerical Integral Reference = 2

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DirectLighting
Rendering.desc: Whether to render all local lights through Lumen's Final Gather, when enabled.  This gives very cheap but low quality direct lighting.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFactor
Rendering.desc: Pixel size of the screen tile that a screen probe will be placed on.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Filtering.WaveOps
Rendering.desc: Whether to use Wave Ops path for screen probe filtering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.FixedJitterIndex
Rendering.desc: If zero or greater, overrides the temporal jitter index with a fixed index.  Useful for debugging and inspecting sampling patterns.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.FullResolutionJitterWidth
Rendering.desc: Size of the full resolution jitter applied to Screen Probe upsampling, as a fraction of a screen tile.  A width of 1 results in jittering by DownsampleFactor number of pixels.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.GatherNumMips
Rendering.desc: Number of mip maps to prepare for diffuse integration

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.GatherOctahedronResolutionScale
Rendering.desc: Resolution that probe filtering and integration will happen at, as a scale of TracingOctahedronResolution

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.HairStrands.ScreenTrace
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against hair depth for hair casting shadow onto opaques.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.HairStrands.VoxelTrace
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against hair voxel structure for hair casting shadow onto opaques.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.HardwareRayTracing
Rendering.desc: 0. Software raytracing of diffuse indirect from Lumen cubemap tree.1. Enable hardware ray tracing of diffuse indirect. (Default)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.HardwareRayTracing.NormalBias
Rendering.desc: Bias along the shading normal, useful when the Ray Tracing geometry doesn't match the GBuffer (Nanite Proxy geometry)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.HardwareRayTracing.Retrace.FarField
Rendering.desc: Determines whether a second trace will be fired for far-field contribution (Default = 1)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample
Rendering.desc: Whether to use Importance Sampling to generate probe trace directions.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample.BRDFOctahedronResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the BRDF PDF octahedron per probe.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample.IncomingLighting
Rendering.desc: Whether to Importance Sample incoming lighting to generate probe trace directions.  When disabled, only the BRDF will be importance sampled.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample.MinPDFToTrace
Rendering.desc: Minimum normalized BRDF PDF to trace rays for.  Larger values cause black corners, but reduce noise as more rays are able to be reassigned to an important direction.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample.NumLevels
Rendering.desc: Number of refinement levels to use for screen probe importance sampling.  Currently only supported by the serial reference path in ScreenProbeGenerateRaysCS.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ImportanceSample.ProbeRadianceHistory
Rendering.desc: Whether to Importance Sample incoming lighting from last frame's filtered traces to generate probe trace directions.  When disabled, the Radiance Cache will be used instead.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.InjectLightsToProbes
Rendering.desc: Whether to inject local lights into probes.  Experimental - fast but causes wrap-around lighting due to lack of directionality and SH ringing.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.IntegrationTileClassification
Rendering.desc: Whether to use tile classification during diffuse integration.  Tile Classification splits compute dispatches by VGPRs for better occupancy, but can introduce errors if implemented incorrectly.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.IrradianceFormat
Rendering.desc: Prefilter irradiance format  0 - SH3 slower  1 - Octahedral probe. Faster, but reverts to SH3 when ShortRangeAO.ApplyDuringIntegration is enabled

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.LightSampleResolutionXY
Rendering.desc: Number of light samples per screen probe, in one dimension.  When the number of lights overlapping a pixel is larger, noise in the direct lighting will increase.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.MaterialAO
Rendering.desc: Whether to apply Material Ambient Occlusion or Material Bent Normal to Lumen GI.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.MaxRayIntensity
Rendering.desc: Clamps the maximum ray lighting intensity (with PreExposure) to reduce fireflies.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.MaxRoughnessToEvaluateRoughSpecular
Rendering.desc: Maximum roughness value to evaluate rough specular in Screen Probe Gather.  Lower values reduce GPU cost of integration, but also lose rough specular.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache
Rendering.desc: Whether to enable the Persistent world space Radiance Cache

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.ClipmapDistributionBase
Rendering.desc: Base of the Pow() that controls the size of each successive clipmap relative to the first.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.ClipmapWorldExtent
Rendering.desc: World space extent of the first clipmap

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.GridResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the probe placement grid within each clipmap

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.NumClipmaps
Rendering.desc: Number of radiance cache clipmaps.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.NumMipmaps
Rendering.desc: Number of radiance cache mipmaps.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.ProbeAtlasResolutionInProbes
Rendering.desc: Number of probes along one dimension of the probe atlas cache texture.  This controls the memory usage of the cache.  Overflow currently results in incorrect rendering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.ProbeResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the probe's 2d radiance layout.  The number of rays traced for the probe will be ProbeResolution ^ 2

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.Stats
Rendering.desc: GPU print out Radiance Cache update stats.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ReferenceMode
Rendering.desc: When enabled, traces 1024 uniform rays per probe with no filtering, Importance Sampling or Radiance Caching.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RoughSpecularSamplingMode
Rendering.desc: Mode 0: use the diffuse SH sample as specular. Mode 1: sample the SH along the main GGX specular reflection vector.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against the screen before falling back to other tracing methods.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal
Rendering.desc: Whether to use HZB tracing for SSGI instead of fixed step count intersection.  HZB tracing is much more accurate, in particular not missing thin features, but is about ~3x slower.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.FullResDepth
Rendering.desc: Whether the HZB traversal should go all the way down to the full resolution depth, which is more accurate but adds incoherency to the inner loop.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.HistoryDepthTestRelativeThickness
Rendering.desc: Distance between HZB trace hit and previous frame scene depth from which to allow hits, as a relative depth threshold.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.MaxIterations
Rendering.desc: Max iterations for HZB tracing.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.NumThicknessStepsToDetermineCertainty
Rendering.desc: Number of linear search steps to determine if a hit feature is thin and should be ignored.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.RelativeDepthThickness
Rendering.desc: Determines depth thickness of objects hit by HZB tracing, as a relative depth threshold.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.SkipFoliageHits
Rendering.desc: Whether to allow screen traces to hit Subsurface and TwoSided Foliage shading models.  Can be used to work around aliasing from high frequency grass geometry.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.MinimumOccupancy
Rendering.desc: Minimum number of threads still tracing before aborting the trace.  Can be used for scalability to abandon traces that have a disproportionate cost.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.ThicknessScaleWhenNoFallback
Rendering.desc: Larger scales effectively treat depth buffer surfaces as thicker for screen traces when there is no Distance Field present to resume the occluded ray.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO
Rendering.desc: Whether to compute a short range, full resolution AO to add high frequency occlusion (contact shadows) which Screen Probes lack due to downsampling.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.ApplyDuringIntegration
Rendering.desc: Whether Screen Space Bent Normal should be applied during BRDF integration, which has higher quality but is before the temporal filter so causes streaking on moving objects.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.HairScreenTrace
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against hair depth for hair casting shadow onto opaques.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.HairVoxelTrace
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against hair voxel structure for hair casting shadow onto opaques.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.HardwareRayTracing
Rendering.desc: 0. Screen space tracing for the full resolution Bent Normal (directional occlusion).1. Enable hardware ray tracing of the full resolution Bent Normal (directional occlusion). (Default)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.HardwareRayTracing.NormalBias
Rendering.desc: Bias for HWRT Bent Normal to avoid self intersection

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.MaxMultibounceAlbedo
Rendering.desc: Maximum albedo used for the AO multi-bounce approximation.  Useful for forcing near-white albedo to have some occlusion.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.ScreenSpace.FoliageOcclusionStrength
Rendering.desc: Maximum strength of ScreenSpaceBentNormal occlusion on foliage and subsurface pixels.  Useful for reducing max occlusion to simulate subsurface scattering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO.ScreenSpace.SlopeCompareToleranceScale
Rendering.desc: Scales the slope threshold that screen space traces use to determine whether there was a hit.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.SpatialFilterHalfKernelSize
Rendering.desc: Experimental

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.SpatialFilterMaxRadianceHitAngle
Rendering.desc: In Degrees.  Larger angles allow more filtering but lose contact shadows.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.SpatialFilterNumPasses
Rendering.desc: Number of spatial filter passes

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.SpatialFilterPositionWeightScale
Rendering.desc: Determines how far probes can be in world space while still filtering lighting

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.SpatialFilterProbes
Rendering.desc: Whether to spatially filter probe traces to reduce noise.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.StochasticInterpolation
Rendering.desc: Where to interpolate screen probes stochastically (1 sample) or bilinearly (4 samples)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal
Rendering.desc: Whether to use a temporal filter

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.ClearHistoryEveryFrame
Rendering.desc: Whether to clear the history every frame for debugging

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.DistanceThreshold
Rendering.desc: Relative distance threshold needed to discard last frame's lighting results.  Lower values reduce ghosting from characters when near a wall but increase flickering artifacts.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.FastUpdateModeUseNeighborhoodClamp
Rendering.desc: Whether to clamp history values to the current frame's screen space neighborhood, in areas around moving objects.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.MaxFastUpdateModeAmount
Rendering.desc: Maximum amount of fast-responding temporal filter to use when traces hit a moving object.  Values closer to 1 cause more noise, but also faster reaction to scene changes.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.MaxFramesAccumulated
Rendering.desc: Lower values cause the temporal filter to propagate lighting changes faster, but also increase flickering from noise.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.MaxRayDirections
Rendering.desc: Number of possible random directions per pixel. Should be tweaked based on MaxFramesAccumulated.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.NormalThreshold
Rendering.desc: Maximum angle that the history texel's normal can be from the current pixel to accept it's history lighting, in degrees.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Temporal.RejectBasedOnNormal
Rendering.desc: Whether to reject history lighting based on their normal.  Increases cost of the temporal filter but can reduce streaking especially around character feet.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TemporalFilterProbes
Rendering.desc: Whether to temporally filter probe traces to reduce noise.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TileDebugMode
Rendering.desc: Display Lumen screen probe tile classification.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TraceMeshSDFs
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against Mesh Signed Distance fields for Lumen's Screen Probe Gather.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TracingOctahedronResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the tracing octahedron.  Determines how many traces are done per probe.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TwoSidedFoliageBackfaceDiffuse
Rendering.desc: Whether to gather lighting along the backface for the Two Sided Foliage shading model, which adds some GPU cost.  The final lighting is then DiffuseColor x FrontfaceLighting + SubsurfaceColor x Backfa

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.VisualizeTraces
Rendering.desc: Whether to visualize traces for the center screen probe, useful for debugging

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.VisualizeTracesFreeze
Rendering.desc: Whether to freeze updating the visualize trace data.  Note that no changes to cvars or shaders will propagate until unfrozen.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.SkylightLeaking.Roughness
Rendering.desc: Roughness used to sample the skylight leaking cubemap.  A value of 0 gives no prefiltering of the skylight leaking, while larger values can be useful to hide sky features in the leaking.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.StereoOptimizations
Rendering.desc: Whether to to share certain Lumen state between views during the instanced stereo rendering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Supported
Rendering.desc: Whether Lumen is supported at all for the project, regardless of platform.  This can be used to avoid compiling shaders and other load time overhead.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.SurfaceCache.HeightfieldCaptureMargin
Rendering.desc: Amount to expand heightfield component bbox for card capture purposes.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.ThreadGroupSize32
Rendering.desc: Whether to prefer dispatches in groups of 32 threads on HW which supports it (instead of standard 64).

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TraceDistanceScale
Rendering.desc: Scales the tracing distance for all tracing methods and Lumen features, used by scalability.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs
Rendering.desc: Whether Lumen should trace against Mesh Signed Distance fields.  When enabled, Lumen's Software Tracing will be more accurate, but scenes with high instance density (overlapping meshes) will have high

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs.Allow
Rendering.desc: Whether Lumen should trace against Mesh Signed Distance fields.  When enabled, Lumen's Software Tracing will be more accurate, but scenes with high instance density (overlapping meshes) will have high

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs.TraceDistance
Rendering.desc: Max trace distance against Mesh Distance Fields and Heightfields.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.ClipmapFadeSize
Rendering.desc: Size in Radiance Cache probes of the dithered transition region between clipmaps

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.Allow
Rendering.desc: Whether to render Lumen Reflections on the frontmost layer of Translucent Surfaces.  Other layers will use the lower quality Radiance Cache method that can only produce glossy reflections.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.DepthThreshold
Rendering.desc: Depth test threshold used to determine whether the fragments being rendered match the single layer that reflections were calculated for. In float ULP units.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.Enable
Rendering.desc: Whether to render Lumen Reflections on the frontmost layer of Translucent Surfaces.  Other layers will use the lower quality Radiance Cache method that can only produce glossy reflections.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.EnableForProject
Rendering.desc: Whether to render Lumen Reflections on the frontmost layer of Translucent Surfaces.  Other layers will use the lower quality Radiance Cache method that can only produce glossy reflections.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.MarkDownsampleFactor
Rendering.desc: Downsample factor for marking translucent surfaces in the Lumen Radiance Cache.  Too low of factors will cause incorrect Radiance Cache coverage.  Should be a power of 2.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.RadianceCache
Rendering.desc: Whether to use the Radiance Cache to provide Lumen Reflections on Translucent Surfaces.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.ReprojectionRadiusScale
Rendering.desc: Larger values treat the Radiance Cache lighting as more distant.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.GridCenterOffsetFromDepthBuffer
Rendering.desc: Offset in grid units to move grid center sample out form the depth buffer along the Z direction. -1 means disabled. This reduces sample self intersection with geometry when tracing the global distance

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.GridPixelSize
Rendering.desc: Size of a cell in the translucency grid, in pixels.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.HardwareRayTracing
Rendering.desc: Enables hardware ray tracing for Lumen translucency volume (Default = 1)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.OffsetThresholdToAcceptDepthBufferOffset
Rendering.desc: Offset in grid units to accept a sample to be moved forward in front of the depth buffer. This is to avoid moving all samples behind the depth buffer forward which would affect the lighting of translu

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache
Rendering.desc: Whether to use the Radiance Cache for Translucency

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.ClipmapDistributionBase
Rendering.desc: Base of the Pow() that controls the size of each successive clipmap relative to the first.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.ClipmapWorldExtent
Rendering.desc: World space extent of the first clipmap

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.FarField
Rendering.desc: Whether to trace against the FarField representation

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.GridResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the probe placement grid within each clipmap

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.NumMipmaps
Rendering.desc: Number of radiance cache mipmaps.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.ProbeAtlasResolutionInProbes
Rendering.desc: Number of probes along one dimension of the probe atlas cache texture.  This controls the memory usage of the cache.  Overflow currently results in incorrect rendering.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.ProbeResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the probe's 2d radiance layout.  The number of rays traced for the probe will be ProbeResolution ^ 2

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.Stats
Rendering.desc: GPU print out Radiance Cache update stats.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.SpatialFilter
Rendering.desc: Whether to use a spatial filter on the volume traces.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.SpatialFilter.NumPasses
Rendering.desc: How many passes of the spatial filter to do

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.Temporal.HistoryWeight
Rendering.desc: How much the history value should be weighted each frame.  This is a tradeoff between visible jittering and responsiveness.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.Temporal.Jitter
Rendering.desc: Whether to apply jitter to each frame's translucency GI computation, achieving temporal super sampling.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.TemporalReprojection
Rendering.desc: Whether to use temporal reprojection.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.TraceFromVolume
Rendering.desc: Whether to ray trace from the translucency volume's voxels to gather indirect lighting.  Only makes sense to disable if TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache is enabled.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.TracingOctahedronResolution
Rendering.desc: Resolution of the tracing octahedron.  Determines how many traces are done per voxel of the translucency lighting volume.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.UsesLightFunctionAtlas
Rendering.desc: Whether the light function atlas is sampled for lumen scene lighting.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize
Rendering.desc: Lumen scene visualization mode.  0 - Disable  1 - Overview  2 - Performance Overview  3 - Lumen Scene  4 - Reflection View  5 - Surface Cache Coverage  6 - Geometry normals  7 - Dedicated Reflection R

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.CardPlacementDirection
Rendering.desc: Visualize only a single card direction.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.CardPlacementIndex
Rendering.desc: Visualize only a single card per mesh.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.CardPlacementLOD
Rendering.desc: 0 - all  1 - only primitives  2 - only merged instances  3 - only merged components  4 - only far field

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.CardPlacementPrimitives
Rendering.desc: Whether to visualize primitive bounding boxes.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.ConeAngle
Rendering.desc: Visualize cone angle, in degrees.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.ConeStepFactor
Rendering.desc: Cone step scale on sphere radius step size.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing
Rendering.desc: Enables visualization of hardware ray tracing (Default = 1)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.BucketMaterials
Rendering.desc: Determines whether a secondary traces will be bucketed for coherent material access (default = 1

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.Compact
Rendering.desc: Determines whether a second trace will be compacted before traversal (default = 1

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.DeferredMaterial
Rendering.desc: Enables deferred material pipeline (Default = 1)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.DeferredMaterial.TileDimension
Rendering.desc: Determines the tile dimension for material sorting (Default = 64)

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.GroupCount
Rendering.desc: Determines the active group count when dispatching raygen shader (default = 4096

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.Retrace.FarField
Rendering.desc: Determines whether a second trace will be fired for far-field contribution (default = 1

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.Retrace.HitLighting
Rendering.desc: Determines whether a second trace will be fired for hit-lighting for invalid surface-cache hits (default = 1

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HardwareRayTracing.ThreadCount
Rendering.desc: Determines the active group count when dispatching raygen shader (default = 64

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.HiResSurface
Rendering.desc: Whether visualization should sample highest available surface data or use lowest res always resident pages.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.IndirectDiffuse
Rendering.desc: Visualize Lumen Indirect Diffuse.

Rendering.name: r.Lumen.Visualize.MaxMeshSDFTraceDistance
Rendering.desc: Max trace distance for Lumen scene visualization rays. Values below 0 will automatically derrive this from cone angle.

Rendering.desc: Scales the half voxel SDF expand used by the Global SDF to reconstruct surfaces that are thinner than the distance between two voxels, for regions of space that only contain Two Sided Mesh SDFs.

Rendering.desc: Enables hardware ray tracing for radiosity (default = 1).

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.HemisphereProbeResolution
Rendering.desc: Number of traces along one dimension of the hemisphere probe layout.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.MaxRayIntensity
Rendering.desc: Clamps Radiosity trace intensity, relative to current view exposure.  Useful for reducing artifacts from small bright emissive sources, but loses energy and adds view dependence.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.ProbeOcclusion
Rendering.desc: Whether to depth test against the probe hit depths during interpolation and filtering to reduce leaking.  Not available with Software Ray Tracing due to imprecision.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.ProbeOcclusionStrength
Rendering.desc: Strength of probe occlusion.  0 = No probe occlusion, 1 = Attempt to stop all leaking, but has self-occlusion artifacts, .5 (default) = tradeoff between the extremes.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.ProbePlaneWeighting
Rendering.desc: Whether to weight Radiosity probes by plane distance, useful to prevent leaking.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.ProbeSpacing
Rendering.desc: Distance between probes, in Surface Cache texels

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.SpatialFilterProbes
Rendering.desc: Whether to spatially filter Radiosity probes.  Filtering reduces noise but increases leaking.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.SpatialFilterProbes.KernelSize
Rendering.desc: Larger kernels reduce noise but increase leaking.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.SpatialFilterProbes.PlaneWeightingDepthScale
Rendering.desc: Controls the distance at which probes can be interpolated from.  Higher values introduce leaking.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.Temporal
Rendering.desc: Whether to use temporal super sampling on Radiosity.  Increases quality, but also adds latency to the speed that lighting changes propagate, and animated noise in the results.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.Temporal.FixedJitterIndex
Rendering.desc: If zero or greater, overrides the temporal jitter index with a fixed index.  Useful for debugging and inspecting sampling patterns.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.Temporal.MaxFramesAccumulated
Rendering.desc: Lower values cause the temporal filter to propagate lighting changes faster, but also increase flickering from noise.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.UpdateFactor
Rendering.desc: Controls for how many texels radiosity will be updated every frame. Texels = SurfaceCacheTexels / Factor.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.VisualizeProbeRadius
Rendering.desc: Radius of a visualized radiosity probe.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.VisualizeProbes

Rendering.desc: Far Field Lumen card texels per world space unit

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.MinPageHits
Rendering.desc: Min number of page hits to demand a new page.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.ResLevelBias
Rendering.desc: Bias resolution of on demand surface cache pages.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.TileSize
Rendering.desc: One surface cache feedback element will be writen out per tile. Aligned to a power of two.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.UniqueElements
Rendering.desc: Limit of unique surface cache feedback elements. Used to resize buffers.

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.ForceEvictHiResPages
Rendering.desc: Evict all optional hi-res surface cache pages.

Rendering.desc: Only merge if the (combined box surface area) / (summed instance box surface area) < MaxSurfaceAreaRatio

Rendering.name: r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.MeshCardsMinSize

Scalability.name: s.RouteActorInitializationWorkUnitWeighting

Scalability.name: s.StorageServerIoDispatcherBatchSize

Scalability.name: s.StreamableDelegateDelayFrames

Scalability.name: s.StreamableFlushAllAsyncLoadRequestsOnWait

Scalability.name: s.TimeLimitExceededMinTime

Scalability.name: s.TimeLimitExceededMultiplier

Scalability.name: s.UseBackgroundLevelStreaming

Scalability.name: s.WarnIfTimeLimitExceeded

Scalability.name: s.World.SkipPerfTrackerForUninitializedWorlds

Safe Zone.name: SafeZone.EnableScale

Scene Outliner.name: SceneOutliner.AutoRepresentingWorldNetMode
Scene Outliner.desc: The preferred NetMode of the world shown in the scene outliner when the 'Auto' option is chosen: 0=Standalone, 1=DedicatedServer, 2=ListenServer, 3=Client

Scene Outliner.name: SceneOutliner.AutoRepresentingWorldNetModeForObjectMixer

Scene Outliner.desc: Maximum time in milliseconds to spend processing operations per frame

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.AddKeepStateDeterminismFences
Sequencer.desc: Whether the Sequencer compiler should auto-add determinism fences for the last frame of KeepState sections. This ensures that the last possible value of the section is consistently evaluated regardles

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.Audio.IgnoreAudioSyncDuringWorldTimeDilation
Sequencer.desc: Ignore correcting audio if there is world time dilation.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.Audio.MaxDesyncTolerance
Sequencer.desc: Controls how many seconds an audio track can be out of sync in a Sequence before we attempt a time correction.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.Audio.PlayAudioWhenPlaybackJumps
Sequencer.desc: Play audio when playback jumps.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.Audio.UseAudioClockForAudioDesync
Sequencer.desc: When set to 1, we will use the audio render thread directly to query whether audio has went out of sync with the sequence.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.AutoScrub

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.AutoScrubCurveExponent

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.AutoScrubSpeed
Sequencer.desc: How fast to scrub forward/backward when auto-scrubbing

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.AutoTangentNew

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.CachedChannelEvaluationParityThreshold

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.DrawMeshTrails

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.MaxLatentActionLoops
Sequencer.desc: Defines the maximum number of latent action loops that can be run in one frame.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.NetSyncThreshold

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.Outliner.RelaxedHeight
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 28.f. Defines the height of outliner items when in relaxed mode.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.OutputDeferredMovementMode

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.RelativeTimecodeSmoothing
Sequencer.desc: If nonzero, accumulate with platform time since when the timecodes were equal.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.SecondsPerFrame
Sequencer.desc: Seconds per frame to wait when in play every frame mode.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.SmartAutoBlendLocationPercentage
Sequencer.desc: Percentage near the next value that the tangent will blend to the adjacent tangent, if over 1.0 we won't blend. Default to 0.8

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.SmoothedMaxNetSyncSampleAge
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 5000. Defines the range of samples (in milliseconds) required to perform smoothed net sync. Use 0 to disable smoothing.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.SmoothedMaxNetSyncSampleCount
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 50. The maximum number of samples to keep in memory.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.SmoothedNetSyncDeviationThreshold
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 200ms. Defines the acceptable deviation for smoothed net sync samples. Samples outside this deviation will be discarded.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.StartTransformOffsetInBoneSpace
Sequencer.desc: When true we offset the start offsets for skeletal animation matching in bone space, if false we do it in root space, by default true

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.TagSaturation
Sequencer.desc: Specifies how saturated object binding tags should appear in the Sequencer UI.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.ThreadedEvaluation.AllocationThreshold
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 32) Defines the entity allocation fragmentation threshold above which threaded evaluation will be used.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.ThreadedEvaluation.EntityThreshold
Sequencer.desc: (Default: 256) Defines the number of entities that need to exist to justify threaded evaluation.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.TickIntervalGroupingResolutionMs
Sequencer.desc: Defines the maximum resolution for actor tick interval groupings. Bigger numbers will group more actors together when they have custom tick intervals, but will lead to less accurate intervals.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.TimeUndo
Sequencer.desc: Enable/disable ability to undo time when making changes

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.UseOldSequencerTrails
Sequencer.desc: If true show old motion trails, if false use new editable motion trails.

Sequencer.name: Sequencer.UseSoftObjectPtrsForPreAnimatedMaterial
Sequencer.desc: Defines whether to use soft-object-ptrs for referencing pre-animated state (default), or strong TObjectPtrs.

Sig Man.name: SigMan.ObjectsToShow
Sig Man.desc: How many objects to display when ShowDebug SignificanceManager is enabled.

Skeletal Mesh.name: SkeletalMesh.UseExperimentalChunking
Skeletal Mesh.desc: Whether skeletal mesh will use a experimental chunking algorithm when building LODModel.

Skeletal Mesh.name: SkinWeightProfileManager.AllowCPU
Skeletal Mesh.desc: Whether or not to allow cpu buffer generation

Slate.name: Slate.AbsoluteIndices
Slate.desc: 0: Each element first vertex index starts at 0 (default), 1: Use absolute indices, simplifies draw call setup on RHIs that do not support BaseVertex

Slate.name: Slate.AccessibleWidgetsProcessedPerTick
Slate.desc: To reduce performance spikes, generating the accessible widget tree is limited to this many widgets per tick to update.

Slate.name: Slate.AllowBackgroundBlurWidgets
Slate.desc: If 0, no background blur widgets will be rendered

Slate.name: Slate.AllowPerUserHitTesting
Slate.desc: Toggles between widgets mapping to a user id and requring a matching user id from an input event or allowing all users to interact with widget

Slate.name: Slate.AllowSlateToSleep
Slate.desc: Whether Slate should go to sleep when there are no active timers and the user is idle

Slate.name: Slate.AlwaysInvalidate
Slate.desc: Forces invalidation panels to cache, but to always invalidate.

Slate.name: Slate.ApplyDisabledEffectOnWidgets
Slate.desc: If true, disabled game-layer widgets will have alpha multiplied by 0.45.

Slate.name: Slate.BackgroundBlurMaxKernelSize
Slate.desc: The maximum allowed kernel size.  Note: Very large numbers can cause a huge decrease in performance

Slate.name: Slate.bAllowNotifications
Slate.desc: If false, then notifications will not be displayed to the user.

Slate.name: Slate.bAllowThrottling
Slate.desc: Allow Slate to throttle parts of the engine to ensure the UI is responsive

Slate.name: Slate.Contrast
Slate.desc: The amount of contrast to apply to the UI (default 1).

Slate.name: Slate.CopyBackbufferToSlatePostRenderTargets
Slate.desc: Experimental. Set true to copy final backbuffer into slate RTs for slate post processing / material usage

Slate.name: Slate.CullingSlackFillPercent
Slate.desc: Scales the culling rect by the amount to provide extra slack/wiggle room for widgets that have a true bounds larger than the root child widget in a container.

Slate.name: Slate.CursorSignificantMoveDetectionThreshold
Slate.desc: The distance from previous cursor position above which the move will be considered significant (used to trigger the display of the tooltips).

Slate.name: Slate.Debug.TraceNavigationConfig
Slate.desc: True enables tracing of navigation config & callstack to log.

Slate.name: Slate.DebugCulling
Slate.desc: Controls whether we should ignore clip rects, and just use culling.

Slate.name: Slate.DefaultEnablePostRenderTarget_0
Slate.desc: Experimental. Set true to enable slate post render target 0

Slate.name: Slate.DefaultTextFlowDirection
Slate.desc: 0: Auto (default), 1: LeftToRight, 2: RightToLeft.

Slate.name: Slate.DefaultTextShapingMethod
Slate.desc: 0: Auto (default), 1: KerningOnly, 2: FullShaping.

Slate.name: Slate.DeferRetainedRenderingRenderThread
Slate.desc: Whether or not to defer retained rendering to happen at the same time as the rest of slate render thread work

Slate.name: Slate.DeferWindowsMessageProcessing
Slate.desc: Whether windows message processing is deferred until tick or if they are processed immediately

Slate.name: Slate.DemoMode.KeyEvent
Slate.desc: Visualize any pressed keys for demo-recording purposes.

Slate.name: Slate.DemoMode.MouseEvent
Slate.desc: Visualize the cursor events for demo-recording purposes.

Slate.name: Slate.DrawToVRRenderTarget

Slate.name: Slate.DumpFontCacheStats
Slate.desc: Dump statistics about font cache usage.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableCrashHandler
Slate.desc: Slate will add states into the crash reporter.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableDeleteUnusedPostProcess
Slate.desc: Greater than zero implies that post process render targets will be deleted when they are not used after n frames.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableDesignerRetainedRendering
Slate.desc: Controls if retainer renders in designer; 0 - Never; 1 - Per Widget Properties

Slate.name: Slate.EnableFastWidgetPath
Slate.desc: Whether or not we enable fast widget pathing.  This mode relies on parent pointers to work correctly.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableFontAntiAliasing
Slate.desc: Enable or disable anti-aliasing for font rendering (0 = off, 1 = on). Enabled by default.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableGamepadEditorNavigation
Slate.desc: True implies we allow gamepad navigation outside of the game viewport.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableInvalidationPanels
Slate.desc: Whether to attempt to cache any widgets through invalidation panels.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableLayoutLocalization
Slate.desc: Controls if we enable or disable localized layout, which affects left to right or right to left detection for cultures.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableLegacyFontHinting
Slate.desc: Enable the legacy font hinting? (0/1).

Slate.name: Slate.EnableRetainedRendering
Slate.desc: Whether to attempt to render things in SRetainerWidgets to render targets first.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableRetainedRenderingWithLocalTransform
Slate.desc: This console variable is no longer useful, as the SRetainerWidget render bugs workedaround by it have been fixed. It will be removed.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableSlateWidgetTracker
Slate.desc: Whether or not we enable the tracking of widgets via the Slate Widget Tracker.

Slate.name: Slate.EnableTooltips
Slate.desc: Whether to allow tooltips to spawn at all.

Slate.name: Slate.EnsureAllVisibleWidgetsPaint
Slate.desc: Ensures that if a child widget is visible before OnPaint, that it was painted this frame after OnPaint, if still marked as visible.  Only works if we're on the FastPaintPath.

Slate.name: Slate.EnsureOutgoingLayerId
Slate.desc: Ensures that child widget returns the correct layer id with OnPaint.

Slate.name: Slate.FlushFontCache
Slate.desc: Flush the font cache.

Slate.name: Slate.Font.AsyncLazyLoad
Slate.desc: Causes unloaded font faces that are lazily loaded, to be loaded asynchronusly, until then the font won't measure correctly.  Once complete the UI will invalidate.

Slate.name: Slate.ForceBackgroundBlurLowQualityOverride
Slate.desc: Whether or not to force a slate brush to be used instead of actually blurring the background

Slate.name: Slate.GameLayer.AllCanvasesVisible
Slate.desc: Show/Hide the viewport slot, player canvas, and debug canvas.

Slate.name: Slate.GameLayer.DebugCanvasVisible
Slate.desc: Show/Hide the debug canvas.

Slate.name: Slate.GameLayer.PlayerCanvasVisible
Slate.desc: Show/Hide the player canvas.

Slate.name: Slate.GameLayer.ViewportSlotVisible
Slate.desc: Show/Hide the slot on viewport

Slate.name: Slate.GlobalScrollAmount
Slate.desc: How much to scroll for each click of the mouse wheel (in Slate Screen Units).

Slate.name: Slate.GrowFontAtlasFrameWindow
Slate.desc: The number of frames within the font atlas will resize rather than flush.

Slate.name: Slate.GrowFontNonAtlasFrameWindow
Slate.desc: The number of frames within the large font glyph pool will resize rather than flush.

Slate.name: Slate.GrowSVGAtlasFrameWindow
Slate.desc: The number of frames within the atlas will resize rather than flush.

Slate.name: Slate.GrowSVGNonAtlasFrameWindow
Slate.desc: The number of frames within the large pool will resize rather than flush.

Slate.name: Slate.HitTestGridDebugging
Slate.desc: Whether to show a visualization of everything in the hit teest grid

Slate.name: Slate.Input.MotionFiresUserInteractionEvents

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationDebugging
Slate.desc: Deprecated - Use SlateDebugger.Invalidate.Enable

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationList.EnableReindexLayerId
Slate.desc: With invalidation system, when a painted widget returns a bigger LayerId that it used to, re-index the other widgets.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationList.MaxArrayElements
Slate.desc: With the invalidation system, the preferred size of the elements array.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationList.NumberElementLeftBeforeSplitting
Slate.desc: With the invalidation system, when splitting, only split the array when the number of element left is under X.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.DumpPostInvalidationList
Slate.desc: Each frame, log the widgets that are processed in the post update phase.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.DumpPreInvalidationList
Slate.desc: Each frame, log the widgets that are processed in the pre update phase.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.DumpPrepassInvalidationList
Slate.desc: Each frame, log the widgets that are processed in the prepass update phase.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.DumpUpdateList
Slate.desc: Each frame, log the widgets that will be updated.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.DumpUpdateListOnce
Slate.desc: Log the widgets that will be updated this frame.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyHittestGrid
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify the hittest grid.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifySlateAttribute
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that the widgets that have registered attribute are correctly updated once and the list contains all the widgets.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyValidWidgets
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that every WidgetProxy has a valid SWidget.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetHeapContains
Slate.desc: Verify that the widget is not already in the list before adding it.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetList
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that the updated list does match a newly created list.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetsAreUpdatedOnce
Slate.desc: Verify that the widgets are painted only once per tick.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetsIndex
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that every widgets has the correct corresponding index.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetUpdateList
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that pre and post update list contains the correct information and they are sorted.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetVisibility
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that the cached visibility of the widgets is properly set.

Slate.name: Slate.InvalidationRoot.VerifyWidgetVolatile
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that volatile widgets are mark properly and are in the correct list.

Slate.name: Slate.LogPaintedText
Slate.desc: If true, all text that is visible to the user will be logged when it is painted. This will log the full text to be painted, not the truncated or clipped version based on UI constraints.

Slate.name: Slate.MaxFontAtlasPagesBeforeFlush
Slate.desc: The number of font atlas textures created and used before we flush the font cache if a texture atlas is full

Slate.name: Slate.MaxFontNonAtlasTexturesBeforeFlush
Slate.desc: The number of large glyph font textures initially.

Slate.name: Slate.MaxSVGAtlasPagesBeforeFlush
Slate.desc: The number of atlas textures created and used before we flush the cache if a texture atlas is full

Slate.name: Slate.MaxSVGNonAtlasTexturesBeforeFlush
Slate.desc: The number of large textures initially.

Slate.name: Slate.MemorylessDepthStencil
Slate.desc: Whether to use memoryless DepthStencil target for Slate. Reduces memory usage and implies that DepthStencil state can't be preserved between Slate renderpasses

Slate.name: Slate.OutlineFontRenderMethod
Slate.desc: Changes the render method for outline fonts.  0 = freetype does everything and generates a bitmap for the base glyph (default).  1 = We override the freetype rasterizer.  Can help with some rendering

Slate.name: Slate.OverrideScissorRect
Slate.desc: Whether to allow Slate to apply a scissor clip to UI elements to prevent certain artifacts.  You might need to disable this if you are drawing UI over a mirror backbuffer while in VR.

Slate.name: Slate.PreventDuplicateMouseEventsForTouchForWindows7
Slate.desc: Hack to get around multiple mouse events being triggered for touch events on Windows 7 and lower.  Enabling this will prevent pen tablets from working on windows 7 since until we switch to the windows

Slate.name: Slate.RequireFocusForGamepadInput
Slate.desc: Whether gamepad input should be ignored by the engine if the application is not currently active

Slate.name: Slate.ResourceManager.LockResourceDuringGC
Slate.desc: Lock the Slate RHI Resource Manager when GCing and when the loading screen has ownership to prevent multithreaded access to the resources.

Slate.name: Slate.ShouldFollowCultureByDefault
Slate.desc: Should we initially follow the culture's flow direction at the window level.

Slate.name: Slate.ShowBatching
Slate.desc: 0: Don't show batching, 1: Show Batching

Slate.name: Slate.ShowClipping
Slate.desc: Controls whether we should render a clipping zone outline.  Yellow = Axis Scissor Rect Clipping (cheap).  Red = Stencil Clipping (expensive).

Slate.name: Slate.ShowOverdraw
Slate.desc: 0: Don't show overdraw, 1: Show Overdraw

Slate.name: Slate.ShowTextDebugging
Slate.desc: Show debugging painting for text rendering.

Slate.name: Slate.SleepBufferPostInput
Slate.desc: The amount of time that must pass without any user action before Slate is put to sleep (provided that there are no active timers).

Slate.name: Slate.SoftwareCursorScale
Slate.desc: Scale factor applied to the software cursor. Requires the cursor widget to be scale-aware.

Slate.name: Slate.TargetFrameRateForResponsiveness
Slate.desc: Minimum sustained average frame rate required before we consider the editor to be responsive" for a smooth UI experience"

Slate.name: Slate.ThrottleWhenMouseIsMoving
Slate.desc: Whether to attempt to increase UI responsiveness based on mouse cursor movement.

Slate.name: Slate.TooltipIntroDuration
Slate.desc: How long it takes for a tooltip to animate into view, in seconds.

Slate.name: Slate.TooltipSummonDelay
Slate.desc: Delay in seconds before a tooltip is displayed near the mouse cursor when hovering over widgets that supply tooltip data.

Slate.name: Slate.ToolTipWrapWidth
Slate.desc: Width of Slate tool-tips before we wrap the tool-tip text

Slate.name: Slate.Transform.FullscreenMouseInput
Slate.desc: Set true to transform mouse input to account for viewport stretching at fullscreen resolutions not natively supported by the monitor.

Slate.name: Slate.UnloadFreeTypeDataOnFlush
Slate.desc: Releases the free type data when the font cache is flushed

Slate.name: Slate.UseFixedDeltaTime
Slate.desc: True means we use a constant delta time on every widget tick.

Slate.name: Slate.VerifyParentChildrenRelationship
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that a widget has only one parent.

Slate.name: Slate.VerifyWidgetLayerId
Slate.desc: Every tick, verify that widgets have a LayerId range that fits with their siblings and their parent.

Slate.name: Slate.WorldWidgetIgnoreNotVisibleWidgets
Slate.desc: Whether to not update the position of world widgets if they are not visible - to prevent invalidating the whole layer unnecessarily

Slate.name: Slate.WorldWidgetZOrder
Slate.desc: Whether to re-order world widgets projected to screen by their view point distance   0: Disable re-ordering   1: Re-order by distance (default, less batching, less artifacts when widgets overlap)

Slate.name: SlateDebugger.bCaptureRootInvalidationCallstacks
Slate.desc: Whenever a widget is the root cause of an invalidation, capture the callstack for slate insights.

Slate.name: SlateDebugger.Event.CaptureStack

Slate.name: SlateDebugger.Event.InputRoutingModeEnabled

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.ServerStreamingSourceMinimumExtraAngle
World Partition.desc: Minimum value added to the angle of the streaming source shape sector used by the server (in degree).

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.ServerStreamingSourceMinimumExtraRadius
World Partition.desc: Minimum value added to the radius of the streaming sources used by the server (in Unreal unit).

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.ShowRuntimeSpatialHashCellStreamingPriority
World Partition.desc: Enable to show a heatmap of the runtime spatial hash grid cells based on their priority (0=disabled, 1=heatmap, 2=grayscale.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.ShowRuntimeSpatialHashGridLevel
World Partition.desc: Used to choose which grid level to display when showing world partition runtime hash.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.ShowRuntimeSpatialHashGridLevelCount
World Partition.desc: Used to choose how many grid levels to display when showing world partition runtime hash.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreaming.EnableOptimization
World Partition.desc: Set to 1 to enable an optimization that skips world partition streaming update  if nothing relevant changed since last update.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreaming.ForceUpdateFrameCount
World Partition.desc: Frequency (in frames) at which world partition streaming update will be executed regardless if no changes are detected.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreaming.LocationQuantization
World Partition.desc: Distance (in Unreal units) used to quantize the streaming sources location to determine if a world partition streaming update is necessary.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreaming.RotationQuantization
World Partition.desc: Angle (in degrees) used to quantize the streaming sources rotation to determine if a world partition streaming update is necessary.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreamingSources
World Partition.desc: Set to 0 to stop updating (freeze) world partition streaming sources.

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreamingStateTimeLimit
World Partition.desc: Maximum amount of time to spend doing World Partition UpdateStreamingState (ms per frame).

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UseMakingInvisibleTransactionRequests
World Partition.desc: Whether the client should wait for the server to acknowledge visibility update before making partitioned world streaming levels invisible.  Changing the value while the game is running won't be consid

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UseMakingVisibleTransactionRequests
World Partition.desc: Whether the client should wait for the server to acknowledge visibility update before making partitioned world streaming levels visible.  Changing the value while the game is running won't be consider

World Partition.name: wp.Runtime.UseReplayStreamingSources
World Partition.desc: Set to 1 to use the recorded streaming sources when playing replay.

World Partition.name: XInput.ForceControllerStateUpdate
World Partition.desc: Force XInput refresh of controller state on each frame.  0: Not Enabled, 1: Enabled

XR.name: xr.VRS.DynamicFoveation
XR.desc: Whether foveation level should adjust based on GPU utilization   0: Disabled (default);   1: Enabled

XR.name: xr.VRS.FoveationLevel
XR.desc: Level of foveated VRS to apply (when Variable Rate Shading is available)   0: Disabled (default);   1: Low;   2: Medium;   3: High;   4: High Top;

XR.name: xr.VRS.FoveationPreview
XR.desc: Include foveated VRS in the VRS debug overlay. 0: Disabled;   1: Enabled (default)

XR.name: xr.VRS.GazeTrackedFoveation
XR.desc: Enable gaze-tracking for foveated VRS   0: Disabled (default);   1: Enabled
